text: Ask how many requests the tool can send to one site, and whether you can stop a reading job halfway. Ask what the tool records when it is refused access to a page. If a tool reports that your site says nothing on a topic, ask whether it could actually read the pages in question. Ask whether the tool can be pointed at internal addresses, and how it knows. Before you let a tool cite the web on your behalf, ask to see the passages it proposed and the ones a person accepted.
